overview: Two categories every physical quantity falls into — one needs just a number, the other needs a number AND a direction.
genZNote: Same unit family, completely different job.

aspects.label: Definition
aspects.valueA: Fully described by magnitude (a number with units) alone.
aspects.valueB: Requires both magnitude and direction to be fully described.

aspects.label: Addition Rule
aspects.valueB: Vector addition (triangle/parallelogram law), accounting for direction.

aspects.label: Can Components Cancel?
aspects.valueB: Yes — opposite-direction vectors can partially or fully cancel.
